goal: Tighten finite base-2 MSD DFAO bounds for the single-seed center column, with matched random and Thue-Morse controls. Prioritize unresolved state boundaries; stop when new proposals are needed.

cards.hypothesis: A 2-state base-2 MSD DFAO fits the first 64 bits of thue-morse.
cards.if_sat: A checked witness bounds this finite prefix from above; compare with matched controls. It is not a uniform nth-bit algorithm.
cards.if_unsat: A checked DRAT refutation bounds this finite class from below; prune only by prefix/state monotonicity. It is not a general complexity lower bound.
